waves.name: Agentic Spine Foundation
waves.goal: Land the canonical Agentic Spine: Programs / Tower / Intelligence / Admin surfaces, S0-S9 context-bundle and disclosure contracts, design canon, page and workflow catalog, and the agentic platform architecture contracts.
waves.nextAction: Spine merged. Hold posture; deeper Programs/Tower/Intelligence depth lives in Waves 2 and 4.

waves.goal: Land the agent mission queue and surface wiring, the unified context builder, the evidence ledger, the model gateway and tool registry stubs, the production readiness validator, and the agent dispatch operating model.
waves.nextAction: Runtime safety backbone merged. Live model gateway routing remains contract-only and is deferred to a later wave.

waves.name: AI Control Tower + Intelligence Depth

waves.name: Program Continuity + Deliverable Loop

waves.nextAction: Program continuity and deliverable contracts merged. Real generated deliverables, runtime save/resume, and live notes ingestion remain deferred.

waves.goal: Land the founder-facing verification runbooks (agentic spine, solution workshop, solution intelligence, agent mission persona, route smoke inventory, golden prompt harness) that gate eventual CI promotion of route smoke, persona crawler, security scan, and observability automation.
waves.nextAction: Runbooks documented. Live CI-backed route smoke, persona crawler, and security scan remain deferred behind PROD5+ and the OPS hardening wave.

waves.name: Private Azure/GCP Deployment Lab
waves.goal: Promote the CLOUD2/CLOUD5 lab blueprints into a real Terraform/Bicep/azd lab path, prove a private-VNet AbarVa boot, exercise the model gateway under egress restriction, and document the matching GCP VPC SC counterpart.
waves.nextAction: Author the CLOUD6 (Azure VNet lab IaC realization) and CLOUD7 (GCP VPC lab IaC realization) slice contracts, gated on founder approval to provision in AbarVa-owned non-production subscriptions.

waves.name: Build Operations Hardening
waves.goal: Harden the deterministic build-operations spine: integration-agent merge protocol, conflict policy enforcement, build wave progress tracker, dispatch queue automation hardening, agent batch acceptance harness, multi-cloud lab harness, production readiness CI ingestion, and the operations-hardening verification runbook.
waves.nextAction: Build operations hardening fully merged via PR #291. Cherry-resolve helper, duplicate-preflight, lane-report validator, worktree-cleanup assistant, secret-hygiene pattern, deployment-status surface, and wave-progress tracker all landed. Next wave: Pattern Library + Quality Governance.
